desc:
Your goal is to jump over the walls and reach the end! Work together, stack up, and push past the impossible!

🚀 Jump on other players to get over the wall!
🌠 Unlock trails and complete the game faster for more rewards!
💎 Open crates to get the best gear in the game!
❓ Play for 7 minutes and unlock a secret reward from the Lucky Block!
🫣 Premium players get a special trail and faster rewards!

⭐ Join the group for daily rewards! ⭐

❤️ Like & Favorite to show support! 👍
